# OAKRIDGE FAMILY MEDICINE - - SOAP NOTE 

PATIENT Jonathan Davis 

DOB 10/14/1995 

MRN 948-20491-A 

DATE OF SERVICE 07/12/2022 

## SUBJECTIVE 

Patient presents with left shoulder pain following a fall from his motorcycle over the weekend. He was traveling at low speed and fell onto his left side. Denies loss of consciousness. Reports localized dull ache over the left AC joint, exacerbated by lifting arm overhead. He works as a tech at NSK; notes lifting is a core duty. 

## OBJECTIVE 

Left shoulder examination reveals moderate focal tenderness over the acromioclavicular joint. Positive painful arc test from 90 to 120 degrees. Range of motion: Active abduction limited to 110 degrees due to pain. No gross deformity. Neurological exam of left arm is intact. X-rays of left shoulder show mild AC joint gapping, no fracture. 

## ASSESSMENT 

1. Left AC joint sprain (Grade I/II). 2. Mild rotator cuff tendinitis secondary to trauma. 

## PLAN 

Rest, ice, Ibuprofen 600mg q6h prn. Physical therapy referred to Hope Valley (12 sessions). Modified duty at work: limit overhead lifting with left arm for 4 weeks.
